selection: Top 50 median daily USDT turnover over preceding 7 completed UTC days among cached USDT linear-perpetual histories with 120 contiguous completed daily bars; present-day Trading status NOT used; no future coverage filter; stablecoin bases excluded
selection_note: Seven-day MEDIAN daily USDT turnover, descending, symbol tie-break. Eligibility based on 120 complete pre-origin daily bars; hourly coverage is audited after selection and never used to silently replace selected symbols. Candidate histories consist of daily caches plus cached delisted hourly-derived histories; not a complete historical exchange census.
funding_caveat: Interval changes produce observed 5/6/7h timestamp gaps as well as 1/2/4/8h. Do not reject those transitions solely for not being a standard interval. Max gap <=8h and agreement across two local caches are consistency checks, not independent proof that no funding event is missing. Current instrument fundingInterval is not historical interval metadata.
instrument_caveat: Cached instrument filters are current snapshot, not point-in-time historical filters. All 50 currently support at least 10x, but historic tier/mark/liquidation data not supplied. Current Trading status was not used to select symbols.
